title: pworksIphone ArtWorks.ai Image-to-Video Derived Runtime Contract
description: Project-derived production request contract for ArtWorks.ai PaaS v3 image-to-video tasks. This is not the provider OpenAPI document.

type.description: Documented task type for this operation.

priority.description: Documented queue priority. Lower values mean higher priority. The deprecated isFast field is intentionally excluded.

image.description: Production policy requires a real image reference. The provider schema documents Base64/data references or HTTPS URLs and marks the field required despite also marking it nullable.

model.description: Must be explicit. The project does not rely on the provider's documented default.

fps.description: Generation request FPS. Model-specific maxima are enforced below. This is distinct from native/output FPS and interpolationFps.

numFrames.description: Requested frame count. Model-specific maxima are enforced below. Accepted counts may be normalized in completed media.

resolution.description: Currently documented and runtime-confirmed ArtWorks image-to-video resolutions.

performance.description: Documented and runtime-confirmed performance enum. The project requires an explicit value.

applyOptimizations.description: Explicit project request switch. Runtime effect remains unmeasured.

applyInterpolation.description: Documented boolean switch controlling whether interpolation is requested.

interpolationFps.description: Documented interpolation target FPS. This is separate from generation request fps and from native/non-interpolated encoded FPS. Runtime support inside the documented enum has conflicting path-specific evidence.

seed.description: Documented signed 64-bit integer field. No provider minimum/maximum or reproducibility guarantee is asserted here.

loras.description: Documented LoRA list. Cross-model compatibility remains unresolved.

fpsConcepts.nativeOutputFps: measured media property; not an interpolation constraint

x-project-contract.interpolationEvidence: Historical interpolationFps=30 late failure and user-reported working Wan 30 are conflicting path-specific evidence; neither is promoted to a universal hard constraint.
x-project-contract.evidencePolicy: Hard validation encodes documented provider constraints, confirmed runtime constraints, and explicit project safety policy. Conflicting, inferred, and user-reported behavior is intentionally not promoted into universal validation rules.
